concerns.text: FR-003 uses the placeholder **[deferred]** for the discard proportion ("System MUST discard the bottom **[deferred]** of videos ...") while also stating a default `filter_discard_percent` of 40 % in the same paragraph, creating a direct contradiction that makes the requirement unverifiable.

SC-001 references a target retain/discard rate as **[deferred]** ("target retain rate of **[deferred]** (i.e., discard **[deferred]**)"), yet the Constitution and FR-003 define the intended discard proportion as 40 % (retain 60 %). The placeholder leaves the success criterion unmeasurable and inconsistent with the design.
